mapper.select: select * from experiment where (state = 2 or state = 3) -- 2：进行中 3：已完成 order by start_time desc -- asc相反为升序 limit 5 -- 查询数量为5条

select * from experiment where 1=1
and ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%') or content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%') )
and creat_time >= #{beginTime} -- 以该天的00:00为准
and creat_time < #{endTime} -- 查询包括当天的话，要在需求日期之上再加一天，去掉等于号
order by creat_time desc -- asc相反为升序
